work_history.title: AI Agent Engineer
work_history.description:

work_history.title: Machine Learning Engineer
work_history.description:

• Automated retraining with Celery and RabbitMQ and tracked model versions using MLflow.
• Developed and evaluated XGBoost and CatBoost models to predict quote conversion probabilities for business decision-making.

work_history.title: AI Engineer
